title: Upfront Share for Oversize Openings
content:
# Upfront Share for Oversize Openings

Window Replacement Contracts. In the required booking deposit of a contract paid by cash, check or card, the oversize upfront share is the portion taken up front of the part of the contract's oversize surcharge lines that the deposit percentage leaves uncovered.

**Rule.** The oversize upfront share is set by the openings the completed final measure recorded above the series standard united-inch bracket: at least 3 openings (the many-oversize opening count) takes the many-oversize upfront share of 1.0, at least one but fewer takes the some-oversize upfront share of 0.5, and none takes nothing.

| Openings above the standard bracket at the completed final measure | Oversize upfront share |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | 1.0 |
| 1 or 2 | 0.5 |
| 0 | Nothing |

## Hypothetical figure

With a deposit percentage of 25%, oversize surcharge lines of $400 and 2 oversize openings recorded, the uncovered part is $300 and the share of 0.5 takes $150 up front.
